title: Burley Recalls Ballz® QR Skewers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The skewer, which connects the Coho XC Cargo Trailer to the bicycle, can shear or bend. This can cause instability of the trailer and the towing bicycle and pose a fall hazard for the bicycle rider. Units: About 2,935 (In addition, about 260 in Canada).

title: Juratoys Recalls Children's Shaving Toys Due to Violation of Federal Phthalate Ban
summary: The brown trim of the shaving kit bags contains levels of a regulated phthalate that exceed the prohibition of specific phthalates. Banned phthalates are toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 13,600.

title: Shower Benches Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Made by Ivena and Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The shower bench can collapse during use, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 70,000 (In addition, about 11,317 were sold in Canada).

title: Vitus 14 and Vitus 16 Kids Bikes Recalled Due to Crash Hazard; Imported by Wiggle (Recall Alert)
summary: The bicycles have handbrakes but no footbrakes. Federal regulations require the bicycles be equipped with both handbrakes and footbrakes. title: Step2® Recalls StepUp Sidekick Learning Towers™ Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The storage tray with cup holders and step can come loose from the tower, posing a fall hazard to the child. Units: About 1,570 (in addition, about 34 were sold in Canada).

title: PetSmart Recalls Top Paw Double Diner Dog Bowls Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The gasket on the bottom of the dog bowls can come off, leaving an unfinished edge, posing a risk of laceration. Units: About 100,300.

title: SKE Outdoors Recalls Kids Bike Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 860.

title: Phoenix 200 All-Terrain Vehicles ATVs Recalled by Polaris Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle speed control stop can break and become stuck, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 13,000 (In addition, 990 units were sold in Canada) (Some of these vehicles were previously recalled in July 2020 and April 2018).

title: The Boppy Company Recalls Over 3 Million Original Newborn Loungers, Boppy Preferred Newborn Loungers and Pottery Barn Kids Boppy Newborn Loungers After 8 Infant Deaths; Suffocation Risk
summary: Infants can suffocate if they roll, move, or are placed on the lounger in a position that obstructs breathing, or roll off the lounger onto an external surface, such as an adult pillow or soft bedding that obstructs breathing. Units: About 3.3 million (35,000 in Canada).

title: Huish Outdoors Recalls Oceanic Adult Dry Top Snorkels Due to Drowning Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco
summary: The bottom purge valve on the recalled snorkels can leak, allowing unexpected water entry, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 76,000.

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls to Repair Propane Portable Heaters Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fitting at the back of the heater can fail to be sufficiently tight, causing the heater to leak propane gas, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 19,000.

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls PTV and Off-Road Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The parking brake catch bracket can wear out and cause the parking brake to fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 6,600.

title: Gas One Recalls Propane Adapter Hoses Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The hose can swell during use causing gas to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 19,500.

title: Kohl's Recalls SONOMA Goods For Life Branded Ultimate Oversized Antigravity Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair can break or collapse when weight is applied, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 31,000.

title: Luyuan Recalls Youth All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Crash Hazard and Violation of Federal ATV Safety Standard
summary: The youth ATVs fail to comply with the requirements of the federal mandatory ATV safety standard, including maximum speed limitations and other mandatory safety requirements for vehicles intended for children under 10 years of age. title: Macy's Recalls Martha Stewart Collection Oil & Vinegar Cruets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass portion of the cruets can break during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 26,150.

summary: The Venom Motorsports youth model ATVs do not meet mandatory safety requirements, including speed restrictions, posing a risk of serious injury or death.
